show.text: Welcome to our company website. We have been building aluminum boats for over forty years, and our family business has grown from a small shop into one of the leading manufacturers in the region. Every boat we build is welded by hand, inspected by our team, and tested on the water before it leaves the factory. Our customers include fishermen, hunters, families, and commercial operators, and each of them expects a boat that will last for decades. We take that expectation seriously. Our engineers design each hull with care, our welders train for years, and our sales staff know every model inside and out. When you call us, you will speak to a real person, not a machine. When you visit our showroom, you will see the boats up close, and you can ask any question you like. We believe that a good boat is the result of good people, good materials, and good process. That is why we use only marine-grade aluminum, stainless hardware, and premium coatings. We also offer a wide range of options, from trolling motors to livewells, from rod lockers to custom consoles. With so many choices, you can build exactly the boat you need. Our dealers are located across the country, and many of them have worked with us for decades. They understand our products, they share our values, and they will help you find the right boat. After the sale, our service department is ready to help with maintenance, repairs, and upgrades.
